aligned_caveats.FR-002: The disconnect debug log (src/actor.rs:926-928) can never run, because DisconnectClient is never sent (see FR-025).
aligned_caveats.SC-005: No test checks that Completion::Timeout is delivered; the new unit test uses an unregistered client (src/repair_test_timeout_cancel.rs:91-114).
aligned_caveats.SC-009: The new io_uring test skips by returning early (counts as passed) when io_uring is disabled (src/repair_test_timeout_cancel.rs:30-38).

drifted.spec_text: The actor `on_idle()` remains active (returns `true`) while clients are connected or inflight operations exist. (spec.md:149)
drifted.actual: Returns clients || inflight || pending_cancels (new condition). The framework treats the return value as a 'did work' park hint: false only increments idle_count and parks for 10 ms after 10M idle calls; it never ends the loop.
drifted.introduced_by_branch: partly (pending_cancels condition); wrong meaning was already there

drifted.spec_text: Component MUST support graceful shutdown via `ControlMessage::Shutdown` which causes `on_idle()` to return `false`, terminating the actor loop. (spec.md:135)
drifted.actual: Shutdown sets shutdown_requested; on_idle then returns false without doing work, but that does not end the loop. The loop ends when shutdown() calls ActorHandle::deactivate(), which closes the channel (ChannelError::Closed -> break) and joins the thread. In-flight ops get no completion.

drifted.spec_text: ... appended to an unbounded per-client FIFO backlog ... (spec.md:136); edge case: backlog accumulates 'until either the ring frees up or `ControlMessage::DisconnectClient` removes the session (dropping the backlog with it)' (spec.md:104)
drifted.actual: Nothing in the crate ever builds ControlMessage::DisconnectClient and IBlockDevice has no disconnect method, so a dropped client's session and backlog are never reclaimed before component shutdown. The DisconnectClient handler, including the FR-002 debug log, is dead code.

drifted.spec_text: Component MUST support `AbortOp` by submitting an `AsyncCancel` SQE to io_uring and sending an `AbortAck` completion. (spec.md:123)
drifted.actual: handle_abort discards the SQ push result; on a full SQ no AsyncCancel is submitted, but the op is still removed from inflight and AbortAck is still sent. Same defect class as the timeout path this branch fixed.

drifted.spec_text: Unsafe code blocks MUST include `// SAFETY:` justification comments. (spec.md:147)
drifted.actual: Five unsafe blocks have no SAFETY comment.

drifted.spec_text: Owns the file descriptor (`OwnedFd`), `DeviceConfig`, `IoUring` ring, client sessions map, inflight operations map, and optional logger. (spec.md:156)
drifted.actual: Also owns pending_cancels: VecDeque<u64> (new), next_handle, shutdown_requested, feature-gated telemetry.

drifted_non_numbered.spec_text: Async operation timeout: Timed-out operations produce `Completion::Timeout` and an `AsyncCancel` is submitted to io_uring. (spec.md:103)
drifted_non_numbered.actual: Timeout is delivered at once. The AsyncCancel is guaranteed (never dropped) but may be deferred over poll cycles via pending_cancels when the SQ is still full after submit()+one retry.

drifted_non_numbered.spec_text: CQEs with `user_data & (1 << 63) != 0` are treated as internal fsync markers and silently ignored. (spec.md:206)
drifted_non_numbered.actual: The filter exists, but nothing sets bit 63 or submits an fsync; only the new test uses the bit, to mark its filler NOPs.

drifted_non_numbered.spec_text: The `on_idle()` actor method returns `false` only when shutdown is requested; it returns `true` while clients or inflight ops exist to keep the actor thread alive. (spec.md:207)
drifted_non_numbered.actual: on_idle also returns false when there are no clients, no inflight ops and no pending cancels; the value is a park hint, not something that keeps the thread alive.

spec_gaps.detail: InflightOp does not keep the caller's DmaBuffer Arc; the kernel may still use the buffer after Timeout/AbortAck (the cancel can now be deferred, and AsyncCancel cannot stop a request already handed to the device). The spec says nothing about ownership. Needs a human decision.

conflicts: spec.md:207 contradicts itself ('false only when shutdown' vs 'true while clients or inflight', which leaves the idle no-client case returning false).
spec.md:135, :149, :207 and plan.md:75 read on_idle's bool as keeping the actor alive or ending it; the framework contract (component-core actor.rs:83-92) says it is a 'did work' park hint.
spec.md:104/:136 rely on ControlMessage::DisconnectClient, which has no caller and no interface method.
